def Critical (B : Forest S.ratio) (p : Clip) (R : PathData G) (f : fieldDir G c 1 → AxisChart G B) : Prop :=
    f 0=0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ω f 0 ∧ ∀ t : S.Choices,
      ContDiffAt ℝ ω (Function.uncurry (tested B t p R)) 0 ∧
        ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0, HasFDerivAt (tested B t p R x) (0 : AxisChart G B →L[ℝ] ℝ) (f x)

proof_context.conclusion: `Critical B p R f` gives `f 0 = 0`, `f` analytic at 0 and `HasFDerivAt (tested x) 0 (f x)` near 0, i.e. z(0)=0 and D_z S(v,z(v))=0 on an analytic branch.

def PriceGap (B : Forest S.ratio) (p : Clip) (R : PathData G) (η : ℝ) := ∀ r, ∀ v : AxisChart G B,
    η*(∑ i : B.Free, ‖v i‖^2) ≤ iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (tested B r p R 0) 0 ![v,v]

proof_context.conclusion: `eta * sum ‖v i‖^2 <= iteratedFDeriv 2 (tested r 0) 0 ![v,v]` is Q = D_z^2 S(0,0) >= eta I.

structure Scene (G : Gauge) (L : Side) (j : ℕ) (K : KernelChoices) (a : ℝ) : Prop where
  χ : ∃ η : ℝ, 0<η ∧ ∀ (c f : Side) (S : StepData c f), S.kernel=K → S.patch.L=L → S.patch.J=j → Larger (G:=G) S →
      ∀ (H : Forest S.ratio) (B C : Bed) (p q : Clip) (W : PathData G) (σ c₀ Λ m v u : ℝ) (T : Towers S.patch.L),
        Towers.Diagonal S B C T → Floor B p f a m → W.Bounds p σ c₀ Λ → Attached B W → Sworn B f G →
          Floor C q c v u → PriceGap H p W η ∧ ∃ ρ,Critical H p W ρ ∧ Guessed H (installed S.ratio T.A0) ρ ∧ HeatG H p W ρ C

proof_context.conclusion: `Scene` gives, with eta depending only on the group, L, j and the kernel choices (not on c or f), `PriceGap H p W eta` and a `Critical` branch `rho`.
